post_filter.note: Soft peak filter only. It should not replace realtime post-fall verification in backend runtime.

notes: Model is trained from scratch in this notebook, then fine-tuned stage by stage.
Artifacts are saved outside production by default to avoid overwriting the current backend model.
No Lambda/custom layer is used, so Keras safe loading is simpler.
post_filter is currently a soft single-window peak filter; full post-fall confirmation should be implemented in backend runtime.
Threshold search uses THRESHOLD_MAX up to 0.99 so the best threshold is not clipped at 0.90.
